d: Among the top attractions at the 2026 APEC Summit was Russian President Vladimir Putin's nuclear briefcase, called Cheget. The Cheget is named after a mountain in the Caucasus and allows the Russian President to launch nuclear strikes from anywhere in the world. The Cheget was developed during the Soviet Era and uses the Kavkaz communications system to launch nuclear codes. After Russia, the US is the only other country in the world that also has a nuclear briefcase.
